content.json:
## Egress containment evidence

**Platform decision rows + receipts are the evidence. HTTP 403, DNS errors, timeouts and the model reply are not.**

**180 s rule for receipt absence:** only count a missing receipt as absent if you read it at least 180 s after the call. Missing evidence is INCONCLUSIVE, never a pass.

Status: PROPOSED. These queries come from `docs/kql-queries.md` and have not been run as written until this workbook is applied. Synthetic data only.

### (a) Decision counts by mode and outcome

The `applicationinsights.azure.com` rows are the agent's own telemetry export, not our tools. Filter on `host` to separate them.

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where DependencyType == "NetworkEgressDecision"
| extend p = parse_json(Properties)
| summarize calls = count() by enforcement = tostring(p.enforcement),
          decision = tostring(p.decision), result = tostring(p.decisionResultCode),
          host = tostring(p.host)
| order by enforcement asc, calls desc

content.json:
### (b) Blocks of our tool calls (Deny under Enforced)

Excludes the agent's own telemetry export to Application Insights (see panel f).

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where DependencyType == "NetworkEgressDecision"
| extend p = parse_json(Properties)
| where tostring(p.decision) == "Deny" and tostring(p.enforcement) == "Enforced"
| where tostring(p.host) !endswith "applicationinsights.azure.com"
| extend run_id = extract(@"(run-[0-9a-f-]{36})", 1, Data)
| project TimeGenerated, run_id, host = tostring(p.host), reason = tostring(p.decisionReasonCode),
          denyReason = tostring(p.denyReasonCode), Data
| order by TimeGenerated desc

content.json: ### (c) Audit would-denies (the same call allowed through)

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where DependencyType == "NetworkEgressDecision"
| extend p = parse_json(Properties)
| where tostring(p.decisionResultCode) == "AuditWouldDeny"
| extend run_id = extract(@"(run-[0-9a-f-]{36})", 1, Data)
| project TimeGenerated, run_id, host = tostring(p.host), reason = tostring(p.decisionReasonCode), Data
| order by TimeGenerated desc

content.json:
### (d) One run: platform decisions and receipts side by side

Set the run id above (empty shows every run). A `Deny / DefaultDeny / Enforced` row on the external host with no `test-receiver` receipt after it is the platform block, only if read at least 180 s after the call. An `Allow` row followed by a `policy-api` receipt is the positive control. An `AuditWouldDeny` row followed by a `test-receiver` receipt is the audit slot letting the same call through.

content.query:
let run = "{RunId}";
let decisions = AppDependencies
    | where DependencyType == "NetworkEgressDecision" and (isempty(run) or Data has run)
    | extend p = parse_json(Properties)
    | project TimeGenerated, source = "platform decision", detail = strcat(
        tostring(p.decision), " / ", tostring(p.decisionReasonCode), " / ", tostring(p.enforcement)),
        where_ = tostring(p.host);
let receipts = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
    | where (isempty(run) or Log_s has run) and Log_s has "\"event\""
    | project TimeGenerated, source = "receipt", detail = "reached the destination", where_ = ContainerAppName_s;
union decisions, receipts
| order by TimeGenerated asc

content.json:
### (e) Hosts reached (any run)

Expect the Application Insights ingestion host to appear as `Deny` under `Enforced`.

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where DependencyType == "NetworkEgressDecision"
| extend p = parse_json(Properties)
| summarize calls = count(), last_seen = max(TimeGenerated) by host = tostring(p.host),
          decision = tostring(p.decision), enforcement = tostring(p.enforcement)
| order by last_seen desc

content.json:
### (f) Telemetry-export denies

The platform also denies the agent's own telemetry to Application Insights. **NOT VERIFIED:** that this is why enforced app spans never land. Compare with the audit slot (same host should be `Allow` / `AuditWouldDeny`) before stating it.

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where DependencyType == "NetworkEgressDecision"
| extend p = parse_json(Properties)
| where tostring(p.host) endswith "applicationinsights.azure.com"
| summarize calls = count(), last_seen = max(TimeGenerated) by enforcement = tostring(p.enforcement),
          decision = tostring(p.decision), reason = tostring(p.decisionReasonCode), host = tostring(p.host)
| order by enforcement asc

content.json:
### (g) Tool invocations, last hour: app spans, app traces, platform decisions and receipts

One timeline across all runs. Under `Audit` you should see the `execute_tool` span, the `demo.tool_result` trace, the decision row and the receipt for each tool. Under `Enforced` the app rows are absent (the platform denies the telemetry export), so read the decision row and the missing `test-receiver` receipt instead (180 s rule). The decision rows carry no run id, so they line up with the app rows by host and time only (inferred, not a join key).

content.query:
let tools = AppDependencies
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and Name startswith "execute_tool"
    | project TimeGenerated, source = "app span", what = Name, detail = strcat("success=", tostring(Success));
let results = AppTraces
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and Message == "demo.tool_result"
    | extend p = parse_json(Properties)
    | project TimeGenerated, source = "app trace", what = tostring(p["demo.tool_name"]),
        detail = strcat("run=", tostring(p["demo.run_id"]), " mode=", tostring(p["demo.policy_mode"]), " succeeded=", tostring(p["demo.succeeded"]), " http=", tostring(p["demo.http_status"]), " error=", tostring(p["demo.error_category"]), " host=", tostring(p["demo.destination_host"]));
let decisions = AppDependencies
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and DependencyType == "NetworkEgressDecision"
    | extend p = parse_json(Properties)
    | where tostring(p.host) !endswith "applicationinsights.azure.com"
    | project TimeGenerated, source = "platform decision", what = tostring(p.host),
        detail = strcat(tostring(p.decision), " / ", tostring(p.decisionReasonCode), " / ", tostring(p.enforcement));
let receipts = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and Log_s has "\"event\"" and Log_s has "receipt"
    | project TimeGenerated, source = "receipt", what = ContainerAppName_s, detail = extract(@"(run-[0-9a-f-]{36})", 1, Log_s);
union tools, results, decisions, receipts
| order by TimeGenerated desc
